messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated gateway timeouts (504) observed from 11:04 UTC. Alerting on-call. Paging tim-oncall :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Summary: spike in 504s hitting /v1/generate via api-gateway-us-east. Error rate up ~8% over baseline. Logs sparse for many requests.

tim-oncall: I'm on it. Any customer-facing impact known?

maria-infra: We're seeing increased 5xx and timeouts at the gateway layer. Upstream model nodes respond ok in some traces but majority show gateway drop. No full request ids in gateway logs for many entries.

kevin-sre: +1 missing request-id. Our trace sampling is low for this route (0.1%). If the logs don't have request_id we can't tie to traces.

oliver-eng: I'm checking gateway health and nginx error logs now. Early grep shows lots of "upstream timed out" and a bunch of truncated request lines.

tim-oncall: Can someone post a short sample of the gateway error?

oliver-eng: ```
[2026-08-21T11:05:12Z] "POST /v1/generate" 504 upstream timed out: 110, client: 10.34.1.5, server: api-gateway
[2026-08-21T11:05:12Z] "POST /v1/generate" 504, client: 10.34.1.8
```

maria-infra: We also see LB 502/504 spikes correlated to a small set of customers behind IP ranges 34.90.x.x and 34.91.x.x.

sara-pm: Which customers? We need to assess SLA/notify if degraded.

kevin-sre: Tentatively: cust-phiproc, cust-lexa (from quick IP mapping). We should confirm.

tim-oncall: Ok, priority: 1) confirm customer impact and notify if >5% of traffic 2) get request-id back into logs ASAP 3) add temporary tracing/metrics to understand call path. Who can flip a stopgap?

maria-infra: I can push a middleware to inject x-request-id at the gateway layer for inbound requests where it's missing. It's a code toggle on the gateway config; low risk. That'll make logs searchable.

oliver-eng: I'll enable debug logging for the gateway-proxy to capture full headers for a short window. We'll stream to a temporary S3 bucket instead of long-term logs. Command: ```kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/gateway PROXY_LOG_LEVEL=debug --record```

kevin-sre: Also increasing trace sampling to 5% for /v1/generate in prod so we can get spans. Temporary change: set trace-sampling config to 0.05 in obs config. I can do that.

tim-oncall: Good. Action items: maria inject request-id, oliver enable debug and stream logs, kevin bump sampling and start a quick trace search. Sara, prepare customer comms draft if impact confirmed. I'll stay oncall until handoff at 12:30 UTC.

maria-infra: Pushing request-id middleware now. Patch: ```patch --git a/gateway/middleware/request_id.go b/gateway/middleware/request_id.go index e3a..1f2 100644
+ func InjectRequestID(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+   return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+     id := r.Header.Get("X-Request-Id")
+     if id == "" { id = uuid.New().String() }
+     r.Header.Set("X-Request-Id", id)
+     w.Header().Set("X-Request-Id", id)
+     next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+   })
+ }
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for gateway/request-id middleware (canary) - build 2026.08.21.11.12

oliver-eng: debug logging enabled, streaming to s3://temp-obs/gateway-debug/2026-08-21-11-15/ - watch for PII, retention 24h only.

kevin-sre: trace sampling increased to 5% for route /v1/generate. K8s config updated and rollout triggered.

maria-infra: Canary looks ok for 2 mins; request-id now appears in logs for injected requests. Example: ```X-Request-Id: 3e8a4f2b-9c1d-4f2a-8b52-2a7d9f6b9c0a```

tim-oncall: Nice. Can we correlate one of the 504s to the upstream node now?

kevin-sre: Found a trace where gateway timed out waiting on model-worker, span shows a retry and a long queue wait on worker pool. Triggered by a burst of requests with long seq lengths.

oliver-eng: Worker nodes show OOM kills on a subset (gpu-node-07) at 11:04:50Z, which may explain backlog. Logs show memory pressure then process restart.

maria-infra: That aligns. Our autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough for the sudden burst. Need to revisit pod eviction thresholds and burst capacity.

sara-pm: Impact: cust-phiproc reported elevated timeouts in support channel starting 11:06 UTC. That's likely within the incident window. Recommend sending an acknowledgment to affected customers and note we're investigating.

tim-oncall: Agreed, Sara please post the incident ack with ETA for an update in 30 mins. Keep message concise.

sara-pm: Drafting: "We are investigating elevated timeouts affecting text generation for a subset of requests. Engineers are actively mitigating; we'll provide an update by 11:45 UTC. Apologies for the disruption." Will send after confirm with tim.

kevin-sre: Mitigation plan: 1) cordon and drain gpu-node-07, 2) increase worker pool size by +20% (manual scale), 3) enable temporary fallback model variant with lower memory footprint for new requests to reduce queue pressure. I can execute 1 & 2 now.

oliver-eng: Prepared fallback variant (sea-lite) already on registry. Need to update routing rule in router config: route weight 90% primary, 10% fallback -> flip to 60/40 for 20m window. I can change routing flag.

tim-oncall: Do it. Also keep debug logs and request-id injection active until we finish root cause. Avoid long retention.

deploy-bot: gpu-node-07 cordon/drain started by kevin-sre.

maria-infra: Request-id injection and debug logs enabled across canary cluster. I'm rolling to remaining gateway replicas now.

kevin-sre: Worker pool scaled +30% and fallback routing flipped to 60/40. Early signs: gateway 504 rate dropping from 8% -> 2.5% over 3 minutes.

tim-oncall: Good improvement. We'll keep monitoring. Next steps: post update to customers at 11:45, follow up with a postmortem focusing on autoscaler thresholds, worker memory limits, and adding permanent request_id instrumentation to all layers. Owner suggestions: infra for request-id, runtime for autoscaler tuning, eng for fallback automation.

sara-pm: Sending ack to affected customers now.

maria-infra: Note for postmortem: observability gap: missing X-Request-Id for ~18% of requests between 10:58-11:06. Stopgap successful but permanent enforcement needed.

tim-oncall: Handoff: I'll remain until 12:30 UTC then hand to kevin-sre for follow-through. If anything spikes again ping me and escalate.

kevin-sre: I'll take 12:30 -> 16:30 UTC. I'll open a follow-up ticket with immediate actions and owners.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress. 504 rate reduced. Next update scheduled 11:45 UTC.

sara-pm: Thanks team. Please add any action items to the incident board and set severity/SLAs in the ticket.

oliver-eng: Logging note: ensure we scrub headers and PII before storing debug logs long-term. Temporary s3 bucket scheduled for deletion in 24h.

kevin-sre: Created ticket INF-2247: "Gateway timeouts due to worker OOMs + missing request-id; stopgap instrumentation applied" with owners: infra/maria, runtime/oliver, eng/kevin.

tim-oncall: Closing this thread for live mitigation. Keep the incident ticket for postmortem and follow-ups. Thanks everyone. :pray:
